name: signal-bell
geometry: Dome scales 1.00 → 1.04 → 1.00. No blur, glow, or gradient. Just breath.
rationale: Presence is the content. The rhythm is decoration; collapsing it to a single 200ms pulse on first paint preserves the notification without sustaining the trigger.
antiPatterns: Wobble or shake on every render
Continuous breath even when no unread state exists
